caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of performance scores across four different prompts, labeled V1, V2, V3, and V4. The vertical axis is labeled "score on the GEMBA-SQM" and is a linear scale ranging from 88 to 100, with tick labels incrementing by 2. The bar representing V1 is blue and has a value of approximately 93.69. The second bar, representing V2, is orange and has a value of approximately 93.8. The third bar, representing V3, is green and has a value of approximately 94.5.  The final bar, representing V4, is labeled with a light purple fill and has a value of approximately 91.1. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors, and they are presented in the order of the prompts shown on the horizontal axis.
